lines.trans: He wanted me to be tough.
I cannot do it, I have not lived enough.
He told me to search within myself.
I searched but there was nothing.
You invented a whole genre on the Internet.
You have your own madness, your own violence.
Audiard wants what lies beneath the surface.
In any case, it is too late now.
No, it is not too late.
I did not call him.
You saved my skin!
Mr. Sarda, follow me, please.
You are free to leave.
I heard you talking last night.
Everyone has fear. He must make this movie.
Thank you very much!
Should I drive? No.
